player_prompt.intro:
Nahak {color} Breakthrough khelgi khre, nahak {direction} {board_size}x{board_size} bor keida khre.
Nahakta mang khelgi khre, nahakta khut thokna mang khelgi khre ama mang eina khelgi khre.
Mang khelgi khre aduga eigi khel amata oina khelgi khre, aduga mang khelgi khre oina khel amata eigi khelgi khre.
Mang khelgi khre aduga eina khel amata mang khelgi khre, nahakta eigi khel amata mang khelgi khre.
UCI gi matik khelgi khre, alai [a2a3] a2 da a3 ta khelgi khre.
* 'a' bor gi eikhoina kolam oina, '1' bor gi eikhoina kolam (Awaang ki matik da).
* Amuba nongmei thabak oina bor gi eikhoina kolam (8x8 bor da 8 kolam). Awaang nongmei thabak oina bor gi eikhoina kolam (8x8 bor da 1 kolam).
Mang khelgi khre aduga eigi khel amata mang khelgi khre, nahakta mang khelgi khre.
